description: Publish now, schedule, or (default when the user did not ask to publish right now) leave a DRAFT of a post on a project's connected accounts. Ask the user before publishing or scheduling: it posts to real accounts. Verify content first: never fake news, copyrighted media or spam. Never use another page's text as the copy or its branded picture as the post's picture: the picture comes from the organization's templates (viralhunt_get_template), either rendered by you and passed in media, or passed as `design` with draft=true so the app renders it when a person approves. Returns {id, status, results, warnings, review_url}: status processing|scheduled|review|draft|partial|failed; results keyed by account id carry each network's own reason when it refused. Two stages sit before sending: Drafts (being worked on) and Review (complete, dated, waiting for an owner or admin). Say which one the post is in. The working agreement: a post the user asks for goes to Drafts COMPLETE (text, image, accounts, tentative time, the project they named; no picture with rights = the organization's template with text only), never to Review unless asked. Hand it over in one five-line message: id and project_name, the url the answer gives (never compose a link), the angle, what you verified and the source, the decision you need. Everything else goes in author_notes. The Drafts page shows one project at a time (name the project); media_removed after a week is retention. A picture made on a template is complete only with its design in the post (pass the PNG in media AND design): a PNG alone is a flat file nobody can edit in the app; the answer says picture_editable: false and viralhunt_update_post with design repairs it. Every picture is made on one of the organization's templates; when none fits, CREATE one (viralhunt_upsert_template, the owner's 'Creates templates' tick) and use it.

allow_duplicate.description: Only when the user wants a second copy on purpose: the duplicate firewall otherwise refuses an account another post of the last 72 hours already carries the same text for (409 duplicate_post when every account is one). An answer with status processing and checking=true means every network was cut and PostProxy is being checked for up to six minutes: never create the post again, read it back with viralhunt_get_post.

assigned_to.description: The member who takes this post over (an id from viralhunt_members; agents count): its board card is assigned to them and they get the notification. Also on viralhunt_update_post.

author_notes.description: For the reviewer, never published: the source link, the picture's origin, what you verified. Put the source link HERE, never in the body (the networks cut the reach).

body.description: Caption/text. Optional if media or design is provided.

card_id.description: The Editorial Board card this post comes from (optional).

carousel.description: Only when the user asked for a carousel: allows several pictures in media. Without it a second picture answers 422 multiple_pictures.

design.description: ALWAYS when the picture was made from a ViralHunt template, even if you also rendered and uploaded the PNG (a PNG alone cannot be edited in the app; the design opens the editor on that template): {"template": "<slug or id>", "format": "feed", "variables": {"text": "…", "highlight": "…", "image": "https://…", "caption": "…"}}. Needs draft=true when media is empty; the app renders it when a person approves.

draft.description: true = a working copy in Drafts you still mean to edit (viralhunt_update_post, then viralhunt_submit_draft). Every draft is also an Editorial Board card (card_id in the answer) that moves with the post: Drafts, In review, Scheduled, Published. Without it, a member or agent token lands the complete post in Review, where an owner or admin authorizes it; nothing is sent either way. An owner token publishes directly.

kind.description: What the post IS. The reviewer applies only that kind's rules (a meme is never asked for a source). A post from a card takes the card's category when omitted.

media.description: Public image/video URLs. ONE picture per post (a post made on a template has exactly one, its render). Check media_limits (viralhunt_targets) before a big video.

networks.description: Post to every account on these networks, e.g. ["instagram","facebook"].

overrides.description: Per network (or per account id), only what that account needs to differ: {"bluesky": {"body": "the 300-character version", "thread": [{"body": "part 2"}]}, "12": {"media": ["…"], "first_comment": "its own first comment"}}. body, media, first_comment, thread. first_comment has three states: key absent = inherits the post's, "" = none on this account, text = its own (to remove one, send "", never drop the key). X 280, Bluesky 300, Threads 500, Mastodon 500. A thread on Bluesky/Mastodon is a reply chain posted after the post is live.

project.description: Project name — REQUIRED if the org has more than one project.

project_id.description: Project id — alternative to project name.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-08-01T15:30:00Z. Omit = publish now (or, with draft, the tentative time is 'when approved').

stage.description: Where the post lands, in one word: draft = a working copy (same as draft: true), review = complete and waiting for an owner or admin, even from a token that could send.

target_account_ids.description: Exact account ids (from viralhunt_targets). Omit = all accounts in the project.

name: viralhunt_schedule
